01 · Welcome
Welcome to Troopod, Wellbeing Nutrition.
This document is your single source of truth for this engagement: scope, process, timelines, and next steps, all in one place. Troopod is a website performance and CRO partner for consumer brands. Wellbeing Nutrition is a science-backed nutrition and wellness brand.
Why we're here
In the preliminary pass, TrooPerformance took average Speed Index from 19.2s to 11.3s in 4 days on a duplicate theme. This engagement ships those gains to production and holds Speed Index under 12 seconds individually on each of the three templates (Homepage, Collection, Product) across a 14-day window.
⚠️
Please note
The 12s target is variable. Speed Index fluctuates with device, network, and time of day, so a result within ±10-15% of the 12s target is treated as on-target.
No changes for 14 days after going live. Once the optimised theme is live, no technical changes (new apps, scripts, or theme edits) should be made to the store for 14 days. Such changes affect performance, and Troopod is not responsible for the resulting impact.

04 · Scope & Offering
What we're doing together.
This engagement is TrooPerformance, Troopod's technical performance optimisation, scoped to the Wellbeing Nutrition Shopify store and held to a single accountable metric.
TrooPerformance: Technical Performance Optimisation
Speed Index accountable · Wellbeing Nutrition Shopify store
✓Single accountable metric: Speed Index under 12 seconds, individually on each of the three templates (Homepage, Collection, and Product pages)
✓Preliminary optimisation already live: a 4-day turnaround versus the 30+ day market norm, done by senior engineers, not a template fix
✓14-day window with active engineering, daily monitoring, and same-day fixes, not a passive wait
✓Before/after report plus a detailed plugin report with actual fixes handed to your internal team to further optimise speed
✓Measured on mobile via Lighthouse 13.3.0; zero UI changes, performance layer only
✓No impact to attribution, tracking, analytics, or data; no scripts removed or modified without your prior approval
⚠️
Please note
The 12s target is variable. Speed Index fluctuates with device, network, and time of day, so a result within ±10-15% of the 12s target is treated as on-target.
No changes for 14 days after going live. Once the optimised theme is live, no technical changes (new apps, scripts, or theme edits) should be made to the store for 14 days. Such changes affect performance, and Troopod is not responsible for the resulting impact.
Common questions
Will this affect the live store or break anything?
No. Work is done on a duplicate theme inside your Shopify admin and reviewed before anything goes live. Nothing is published until your team is satisfied with the results.
Will the design or UI of the store change?
No. Work is limited to the performance layer: code, scripts, and assets. The store looks exactly the same and loads faster.
How will we know what changed?
You receive a before/after PageSpeed report plus a detailed plugin report with actual fixes, giving full visibility into every change and what was driving the slowdown.

06 · How It Works
AI-led execution with human QA.
Our TrooPerformance agent runs a comprehensive parallel audit and fix cycle: what typically takes agencies months, we deliver in days.
1
Key pages + baseline audit
All key pages identified and current PageSpeed scores recorded as the baseline. Agent then fetches the live theme, runs Lighthouse, and maps all performance issues: images, CSS, JS, fonts, third-party scripts, Core Web Vitals, DOM, accessibility, SEO.
Day 1-2
2
Parallel fix execution
All issues fixed simultaneously: image optimisation, CSS cleanup, JS optimisation, font loading, third-party script management, critical CSS extraction, resource preloading.
3-4 days
3
Manual QA
All optimisations reviewed by our engineer: catching edge cases, visual regressions, and any unintended side effects before the theme is uploaded.
Day 5-7
4
Duplicate theme upload
Optimised theme uploaded separately in Shopify admin. Live store untouched. You review and publish when ready.
Day 7-10
5
Before/after report
Full PageSpeed Insights comparison across all key page templates: with links to live reports for independent verification.
Day 10-14
6
Third-party scripts and plugins report
A detailed breakdown of all third-party scripts and plugins running on the store; ranked by performance impact. Gives your team full visibility into what is slowing the site down the most, so you can make informed decisions on what to keep, remove, or replace.
Day 10-14

11 · Baseline Audit
Pre-optimisation baseline.
The current performance state of the Shopify storefront on 25 August 2026, before any changes are made. This is the official baseline every optimisation is measured against.
1 · Audit Overview
Store URLwellbeingnutrition.com (wellbeing-india.myshopify.com)
Date of auditAugust 25, 2026
Shopify themeImpulse (Archetype Themes), theme version 7.5.1, customized
Pages testedHomepage (1), Collection template (3 sampled), Product template (4 sampled)
Testing toolGoogle Lighthouse CLI 13.3.0, Chrome (headless)
DeviceMobile and Desktop (tested separately)
Network conditionsMobile: simulated Slow 4G, 4x CPU slowdown (Moto G Power preset). Desktop: Lighthouse desktop preset (light throttling).
Throttling methodSimulate / "lantern" modeling, the same method Google PageSpeed Insights uses by default, so these figures are directly comparable to a PSI check on the same URL.
Number of test runs3 runs per URL per device; the value used per URL is the median of the 3 (standard Lighthouse guidance to reduce run-to-run variance), then averaged across the sampled URLs within each template.
Collection and Product figures throughout are averages across the sampled URLs of that template only. They are not blended with each other or with any other page type (blog, static page, cart, search).
